author: BlackBeltTom
body:
• Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed) - BlackBeltTom

  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned - I was banned for the Derp Hack.

  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. - I am sorry that i used this hack and i no longer use hacks, i have been banned for over 6 months now and i want to be let back in the server because i enjoyed this server very much. I havent appealed a ban before this is my first one. I have never ban evaded. I admit i was using Derp and the report wasnt false. I have only been banned from avicus network this once and i dont plant on hacking or getting banned again.

title: BlackBeltTom's Ban Appeal

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello BlackBeltTom,

I have decided to accept your appeal, as you have waited 4 months as a banned user, and the specified hacks you were using are not significantly game-changing. However, please keep in mind that if you are banned again, your chances of appealing your punishment again will be very low. Please be sure to read the updated rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back to the server!
 
Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
